title: Screening of Riboflavin Binding Protein from Avian Eggs for Anti-Cancer Activity
author: P. Koteshwar Rao
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Purify RfBP from egg white
steps.instruction: Purify riboflavin binding protein (RfBP) from avian egg‑white by first performing DEAE‑Sephadex A‑50 ion‑exchange chromatography, then polishing on Sephadex G100 gel‑filtration; estimate protein concentration with the Lowry method and assess purity by cylindrical and slab gels and SDS‑PAGE, confirming a single 29 kDa band.

substeps.instruction: Perform DEAE‑Sephadex A‑50 ion‑exchange chromatography on the egg‑white extract.
Run the eluate on a Sephadex G100 column for gel‑filtration purification.
Determine protein concentration using the Lowry method.
Evaluate purity with cylindrical and slab gels and SDS‑PAGE; verify a single band at 29 kDa.

steps.title: Raise rabbit antiserum
steps.instruction: Emulsify the purified RfBP in Freund’s complete adjuvant, inject subcutaneously at multiple sites in a rabbit weekly for 4 weeks, then collect the anti‑serum from the ear vein 7 days after the final booster.

substeps.instruction: Emulsify purified RfBP in Freund’s complete adjuvant.
Inject the emulsion subcutaneously at multiple sites in a rabbit once per week for 4 weeks.
After the booster injection, collect rabbit antiserum via the ear vein 7 days later.

steps.title: Assess cytotoxicity by MTT
steps.instruction: Incubate HeLa cervical cancer cells with the rabbit antiserum, add MTT reagent (3‑(4,5‑dimethyl thiazol‑2‑yl)-2,5‑diphenyl tetrazolium bromide) to measure metabolic activity, and calculate cell viability; more than 85 % cell death indicates activity.

substeps.instruction: Seed HeLa cervical cancer cells in appropriate culture plates.
Treat the cells with the rabbit anti‑RfBP serum.
Add MTT reagent (3‑(4,5‑dimethyl thiazol‑2‑yl)-2,5‑diphenyl tetrazolium bromide) and incubate to allow formazan formation.
Measure absorbance and calculate cell viability; record that >85 % cell death was observed.

steps.title: Confirm death with trypan blue
steps.instruction: Perform trypan blue dye exclusion on the treated cells and count viable versus dead cells to corroborate the >85 % death.

substeps.instruction: Mix the treated cell suspension with trypan blue dye.
Count stained (dead) and unstained (viable) cells under a microscope.
Confirm that the proportion of dead cells matches the >85 % cell death observed in the MTT assay.

steps.title: Document activity percentages
steps.instruction: Record the anti‑cancer activity of RfBP from each source: Pea cock (Pavo cristatus) egg‑white 87.7 %, Hen (Gallus gallus) egg‑white 87.5 %, egg‑yolk 86.2 %, Emu (Struthio camelus) egg‑white 85.0 %.
